title: mobileRobotsNavigation.py: the planned paths and the distance map in the renderer and in matplotlib
author: Claude-JG
description: The example shows only the motion. Decided: the planned paths as ground objects and the distance map of the grid as a texture on the floor, and a matplotlib figure of the map with the paths.
releaseNotes: mobileRobotsNavigation.py shows the distance map as texture, the planned paths and sensor traces in the renderer, and a matplotlib figure of them.
